newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Reuters 3rd ex-Hong Kong to Europe air cargo report.
newsitem.headline: Reuters 3rd ex-Hong Kong to Europe air cargo report.

text.p: Below are the current average ex-Hong Kong to Europe and the Middle East air cargo market rates in Hong Kong dollars per kg for a 100kg shipment, with volume-to-weight of six to one.

*The rates quoted in this report were obtained by Reuter journalists on a confidential basis from a range of airlines, large forwarders and smaller air cargo agents based at or near Hong Kong's Kai Tak airport.
*All prices are quoted in HK dollars.

*The tariffs represent average rates calculated from a range of prices, including standard, discount and spot rates, and are indicative of current activity. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com -Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017 -www.racs.com
